summary: Frontend-only mobile regression completed for new Search, Starred, and User Profile routes plus sign-in baseline. Root sign-in, /search, /starred, and direct /user/[userId] all rendered without crash in signed-out context.

ui_bugs.issue: People result row keyExtractor supports item.userId, but onPress/onMessage use only item._id. If API returns userId (without _id), taps can navigate to /user/undefined or fail direct-chat action.

integration_issues.flow: (tabs)/chats search button and (tabs)/profile starred button runtime validation
integration_issues.issue: Tabs are auth-gated and redirected to sign-in in signed-out automation, so in-session tapping of search-btn/starred-btn was not reachable in this run. Route target validity was verified by direct route checks and code review.

integration_issues.flow: Direct /user/[userId] load in signed-out fallback context
integration_issues.issue: UI renders fallback safely, but console shows Convex users:getUserById server error for invalid/signed-out query path during data fetch.

issues: No obvious spacing/contrast regressions observed in mobile viewport; segmented controls and message icon button meet >=44px touch target in current styles.

action_items: Update search people row handlers to use item._id || item.userId for profile and message actions.
Run one authenticated manual/automation pass to click search-btn from Chats and starred-btn from Profile end-to-end.
Optionally harden /user/[userId] fallback query path to avoid noisy Convex server warnings for invalid or unauth states.
critical_code_review_comments: Stack registration includes search, starred, and user/[userId], so routes are no longer dead from navigation configuration perspective.
In search.tsx, userResults actions depend only on _id while query/key handling allows userId, creating a probable ID-field mismatch bug.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Credentials and auth docs were reviewed before testing. New routes are stable when opened directly while signed out. Auth-gated tabs still redirect to sign-in, so button-level runtime verification inside tabs needs authenticated session.
rca_of_issue: Primary RCA: Search People flow has an identifier inconsistency. Repro path: if api.users.searchUsers returns objects with userId but no _id, tapping search-user-result-* or search-user-message-* uses undefined ID in router.push/getOrCreateDirect. Mitigation: normalize user identifier once (const targetUserId = item._id || item.userId) and reuse in all actions.
